acceptanceCriteria: Every committed map is cem/1.0; the migration PR check re-runs the converter over each provenance-named source blob and requires byte equality with the committed file, with the run retained as evidence.

Both consumers re-verify every migrated map with no unexplained verdict difference; the V1-1262 report over the migrated maps matches the pre-migration citation baseline (tiers identical) or the stop is recorded.
Use-case receipts are repinned and sealed-cem-modified / sealed-cem-drift compare against the migration commit's blobs.
body: Source: decision 0525 (docs/decisions/0525-cem-1-0-only-rc3-2026-10-11.md, PR beamfall/corvint#819), owner instruction 2026-10-11 that rc.3 ships cem/1.0 as the only CEM. Owner lane: orchestrating session; the CEM 1.0 vision session owns the wire (V1-1262/1273/1263/1264/1265/1266). Run the converter over every committed .corvint/changes/<bind>.cem.json and rewrite each in place in one migration commit (file name stays the bind commit; provenance names the 0.2 blob). Both the native consumer and interop/cem01-go re-verify every migrated map; repin conformance/use-cases-v0 receipts (script/repin-use-case-receipts.sh); rerun the V1-1262 report beside the retained baseline docs/build-log/2026-10-12-cem-citation-baseline-593-maps.md. The migration commit becomes the new seal baseline for sealed-cem-modified and sealed-cem-drift. Kill criteria (decision 0525): any verify difference or citation-block difference not explained by a section 4 empty member stops the run, is recorded, and blocks the 0.x removal.
title: cem/1.0 decision 0525 step 6: migrate all committed .corvint/changes maps to cem/1.0 in one commit
